business_summary: Zenken Corporation provides IT, language education, and real estate services in Japan. It provides content marketing, media, overseas IT talent recruitment, and AI services; and language training services for corporations, study abroad placement, and Japanese language education services. The company also engages in renting out buildings; and offers nursing care services. In addition, it operates media platforms such as BiPro, which introduces job opportunities in the beauty industry. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
